🎬 Rebel Ridge (2024) — Action, Thriller
Rebel Ridge (2024) follows Terry Richmond, a former Marine who arrives in a small town with one simple goal: to post bail for his cousin. But when local police seize his money through a questionable legal process, Terry realizes that getting it back will be far more difficult than he expected.
As Terry uncovers corruption within the town's justice system, he finds himself caught between powerful officials and people who have learned to stay silent. His military experience gives him the skills to fight back, but he also understands that confronting the system directly could put innocent people at risk.
The film explores themes of corruption, justice, abuse of power, and the struggle of ordinary people against institutions that are supposed to protect them. Rather than relying only on explosive action, Rebel Ridge builds tension through Terry's intelligence, patience, and determination to expose what is happening.
More than just an action thriller, Rebel Ridge is a story about standing up against injustice when the people responsible for enforcing the law become part of the problem. 🔥
💬 What would you do if the system meant to protect you became the thing you had to fight against? 👇

source_details.synopsis: Rebel Ridge is a 2024 American action thriller film written, produced, directed and edited by Jeremy Saulnier. The film stars Aaron Pierre as Terry Richmond, a former Marine; he has the funds needed to post bail for his cousin, but the money is unjustly seized via civil forfeiture by a small town's corrupt police force. Don Johnson, AnnaSophia Robb, David Denman, Emory Cohen, Steve Zissis, Zsané Jhé, Dana Lee, and James Cromwell also appear in the film. Rebel Ridge was released by Netflix on September 6, 2024 to positive critical reviews. It won the Critics' Choice Television Award for Best Movie Made for Television and the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Television Movie.
